pipeline.description: How we scaled a freelance visual design practice into a registered corporate studio model:

steps.title: Incorporation
steps.desc: Navigating MCA filing under U72900GJ2022OPC131119 as sole director.

steps.title: Client Management
steps.desc: Moving from ad-hoc freelancing to structured multi-month retainer contracts.

steps.title: Creative Scale
steps.desc: Building custom templates and asset libraries to output agency-scale creative volume.

milestones.title: Incorporated Haus of Pixels OPC Pvt Ltd
milestones.desc: Formally registered the studio in Anand, Gujarat, giving the creative practice a legal entity.

outcomes.retrospective: Establishing a corporate shield allowed taking on larger startup and enterprise clients with formal service agreements and IP transfers. Moving from an individual practitioner to a studio setup created a structure for future growth.
outcomes.status: Active corporate entity holding intellectual property and serving as the billing structure for consulting engagements.

pipeline.description: Translating raw camera metadata into decentralized proofs of creative ownership:

steps.title: Concept Validation
steps.desc: Prototyping an automated market maker (AMM) model for camera sensor data.

steps.title: Whitepaper Design
steps.desc: Drafting technical tokenomics and validator models for token distribution.

steps.title: Accelerator Run
steps.desc: Pitching and integrating within the global NEAR Protocol ecosystem.

milestones.title: Co-Founded Pixelate Protocol
milestones.desc: Conceived the initial AMM structure for camera-sensor photographs ('Pixel Tokens').

milestones.title: Wins Startup Weekend Bangalore
milestones.desc: A high-intensity 54-hour sprint that validated the protocol's core blockchain value proposition.

outcomes.retrospective: Pixelate was an ambitious run at the intersection of photography and decentralized ledger tech. While the token never reached production scale, it provided deep expertise in NEAR protocol, Rust contracts, and tokenomics design.
outcomes.status: Wound down in July 2024, closing a foundational 7-year chapter and freeing up capacity for focused visual consulting.

pipeline.description: Developing cohesive branding systems and multi-channel asset pipelines for Web3 products:

steps.title: Identity Design
steps.desc: Building core brand identities and vector systems for Rabble Labs and Scribble.

steps.title: Design Systems
steps.desc: Packaging styles, typography, and colors into reusable Figma libraries and components.

steps.title: Content Engine
steps.desc: Running a high-velocity template pipeline for pitch decks, proposals, and social graphics.

milestones.title: Began Rabble Labs Engagement
milestones.desc: Joined Rabble Labs and BuidlersTribe to lead visual design systems across brand and product.

outcomes.retrospective: Working with Rabble Labs consolidated my experience running a design sprint inside an active product-led startup. Creating systems that developers and marketers could easily utilize kept product iterations rapid.
outcomes.status: Retainer completed in May 2026 following team restructure; currently open to next design consultancy roles.

pipeline.description: Managing a fully remote 2D animation production pipeline from script to final sync:

steps.title: Asset Creation
steps.desc: Setting character guidelines, background keys, and color boards.

steps.title: Remote Pipeline
steps.desc: Orchestrating scene layouts, rough passes, clean-ups, and color fills across remote tools.

steps.title: Post & Sound
steps.desc: Supervising voiceover sync, sound design, and sound-effects layers in post-production.

milestones.title: Buddy Tales Series Directing
milestones.desc: Led the remote pipeline under Shivanata Production LLP to successfully complete the animated series.

outcomes.retrospective: Buddy Tales demonstrated the efficiency of lightweight, highly organized remote pipelines. Clear asset definitions and rigorous sequence tracking allowed a small team of four to deliver high-quality, character-driven narrative animation.
outcomes.status: Completed and delivered to client; serves as a primary case study for animation pipeline management.

pipeline.description: Engineering an interactive portfolio system blending editorial typography and a real-time WebGL city model:

steps.title: 3D Optimization
steps.desc: Decimating, Draco-compressing, and texturing a 1.5GB GLB model down to a web-ready 41.6MB.

steps.title: Data Extraction
steps.desc: Building custom scripts to extract EXIF data from photos and normalize the 15-year ledger.

steps.title: Component Design
steps.desc: Integrating Fluent UI Web Components and mapping state dynamically into a no-bundler native ES modules layout.

milestones.title: Interactive City Release
milestones.desc: Released the physical city-map interface with customized building hovers and roles filters.

outcomes.retrospective: Building this portfolio was an exercise in technical optimization. Combining complex Three.js render passes, GSAP camera movements, and Fluent UI elements without using a heavyweight bundler resulted in an fast-loading, immersive website.
outcomes.status: Active personal website and live portfolio, serving as a primary sandbox for creative tech experiments.
